knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Damaged items are stopped from use, and a replacement is requested before clothing or footwear becomes unsafe. A suitable replacement is confirmed before the next hazardous task.
Defects are documented when required and reported to the supervisor, so the item is not handed on as fine.
The procedure says to store clean and used clothing separately.

Wearing footwear with worn grip for a hazardous task is the unsafe choice, because worn grip is a defect to be replaced first. Storing used clothing apart, requesting replacement early and documenting PPE and defects are the safe practices.
Issued PPE and defects are documented when required, and a replacement is requested before the next hazardous task.

practicalCriteria: Checks the site/task requirements before acting
Identifies and applies relevant safety and privacy controls
Communicates professionally and respects authorisation boundaries
Records the outcome and escalates unresolved issues correctly
passRule: All safety-critical criteria must be demonstrated; remediate and reassess any missed criterion.
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 7: Document issued PPE and defects when required.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 5 is not done: Do not take heavily contaminated protective clothing home where workplace procedures require controlled laundering or disposal.
Stop work if procedure step 6 is not done: Request replacements before clothing or footwear becomes unsafe.
Stop work if procedure step 8 is not done: Confirm a suitable replacement before the next hazardous task.
